title: Higher-Order Multiscale Computational Method for Multi-Continuum Problems in Highly Heterogeneous Media
summary: This paper presents a high-accuracy higher-order multiscale method for solving multi-continuum problems in in highly heterogeneous media. First, microscopic unit cell functions are defined, leading to the derivation of macroscopic homogenized equations and formulas for calculating effective parameters, which yield a higher-order multi-scale (HOMS) asymptotic solution. Subsequently, the pointwise approximation properties of this solution to the original equations are analyzed, and its convergence rate in the integral norm is rigorously established under certain assumptions.
